facts.business: Suncare Traders Limited is a listed company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company had made an investment in debentures amounting to ₹200 lakhs in September 2021. However, the original debenture certificate was not produced for our verification. The Company was unable to provide sufficient appropriate audit evidence to confirm the existence, terms, and valuation of the said investment. Consequently, we were unable to determine whether any adjustments were necessary in respect of this item.

key_risks: Inability to verify existence, terms, and valuation of investment in debentures of ₹200 lakhs due to missing original certificate
